what: Ben's Fusion check F3: Combine Cut where a 40 × 40 tool swallows a 20 × 20 target (strictly inside it, touching nowhere). Fusion: 'Compute Failed', both bodies kept. Ours: the Combine fails with words on its row and both bodies stay exactly as they were. No face of the tool lies in a plane of the target's (35b refuses faces lying on each other until 36a), which is why the parts sit off the origin planes as they do.
